name: mnemerynne
description: Search your Mnemerynne documents (inbox and shared libraries) from Claude, with citations, and edit text, Word and Excel files.
long_description: Lets Claude search the documents you can see in Mnemerynne and answer with the file, page and section for every claim, linking back to Mnemerynne. With a token that's allowed to edit, Claude can also create and change .txt, .md, .docx and .xlsx files in your Agents folder (and wherever an admin allows); every change keeps the previous version. Uses a personal token you create under Claude in Mnemerynne; what Claude may search and edit is set by Mnemerynne's admins.
